messages.subject: How to set the color of lines which links the two trees vary with the tips information?
messages.subject_clean: How to set the color of lines which links the two trees vary with the tips information?
messages.body_plain:
Hi, Dr. Yu
I am a fresh follower of ggtree since 2 weeks ago. GgTree is such a powerful and flexible tool to explore the phylogenetic trees.
My goal is to explore the reassortment between the different segments of the influenza virus. The incongruence tree is one of the apparent ways to show potential reassortment between the different segments. Just like this picture.

So far, I already linked the tree. But I was struggled with how to set the line color which can vary with the tips information (which is Host here).
As I said, I am a new learner of ggtree and even the R. Lots of things waiting for me to learn. I was trying to set the geom_line and failed to achieve that.

So, could you please help me figure this last step?
Thanks a lot

Here is the meta data

x <- read.tree('./H7N9_HA.newick')

y <- read.tree('./H7N9_NA.newick')

p1 <- ggtree(x)

p2 <- ggtree(y)

d1 <- p1$data

d2 <- p2$data

tip_metadata <- read.table("meta_data.txt", sep="\t", header=TRUE,check.names=FALSE, stringsAsFactor=F)

d2$x <- max(d2$x) - d2$x + max(d1$x) + 1

pp <- p1 + geom_tree(data=d2)

dd <- bind_rows(d1, d2) %>%

  filter(!is.na(label))

pp <- pp %<+%tip_metadata +

  geom_tippoint(aes(color= Host), size= .3) +

  scale_color_manual(values=c("cyan", "green", "red", "blue", "lightcyan", "springgreen", "pink", "grey", "royalblue", "black")) +

  geom_line(aes(x, y, group=label), data=dd, color='red', alpha = .1)+

  theme(legend.position="right")

pp

tr <- rtree(15)

gg <- ggtree(tr) +
      geom_tiplab(size=3,  fontface='italic') +
      geom_text2(aes(subset=!isTip, label=node), hjust=-.3) +
      geom_hilight(23, fill="wheat2", alpha=0.3, extend=0.35) +
      geom_cladelabel(23, "clade", barsize=1, offset=0.36, offset.text=0.005, fontsize=3)
plot(gg)

#No cladelabel and warning returned, also strange highlight after collapsing

gg.col <- collapse(gg, node=25)
plot(gg.col)

I'm not sure if this is a bug or I'm missing something obvious. Thanks very much,

Rowena
